svg.title: Scan-to-CATIA engineering case
svg.desc: Generated sheet scan with three inspected sides, a withheld region and a zoomed cross-section with competing wall supports.

g.text: From one sheet scan to a CAD handoff
Synthetic workpiece • Section provenance • Editable tangent lines and arcs

A second wall crosses the same probe height.
